items.note: Consistent lighting and depth over the reviewed full-resolution still. Presentation AA and comparative edge roughness remain Phase 7 work; this is not a superiority claim.
Converged and interactive stills are finite and populated without visible shell holes. Independent profile winding regressions pass; moving-frame temporal stability is not certified by stills.
All engines use the same fitted physical camera; four subunits or both DNA strands remain in frame. Palette and backbone guide-policy differences are recorded rather than compared pixelwise.
Both DNA backbone strands remain visible and follow the source C4-prime guides. Mol* and PyMOL backbone guide conventions are not claimed identical.

The selected nucleic profile changes the backbone cross-section and preserves authored physical width/aspect. The case intentionally selects only C4-prime guides to isolate backbone profiles from pending nucleotide-ring work.

reference_notes: Mol* receives explicit helixProfile/nucleicProfile and polymer-trace-only visuals.
PyMOL uses cartoon mode 3 (oval) or 2 (rectangle); rounded has no exact stadium-profile adapter control, so its default cartoon serves only as a fold and visibility reference.
PyMOL DNA includes ladder connectors in its cartoon even with ring mode 0; those connectors are outside this backbone-profile checklist.
